title: Loading in parallel
description:
Load data from a fake API one after another, then all at once, and compare the times.

```
One by one: Ada, Bob, Cy in 600 ms
All at once: Ada, Bob, Cy in 200 ms
With one failure: 2 loaded, 1 failed (User 9 not found)
```
hints: `Promise.all(ids.map(fakeFetchUser))` starts every request before waiting for any of them (lesson 4.03).
Each `allSettled` result has `status` (`"fulfilled"` or `"rejected"`) and `value` or `reason`.
requirements: `fakeFetchUser(id)` (in the starter) resolves after 200 ms, or rejects for an unknown id.
`loadSettled(ids)` uses `Promise.allSettled` and reports how many loaded and which failed.
Measure with `Date.now()`; times will differ slightly.
stretch: Write `loadLimited(ids, limit)` that never runs more than `limit` requests at the same time.
